items.name: Enterprise Hulk Towed from Newport News Shipbuilding
items.summary: The hulk of former nuclear aircraft carrier USS Enterprise (CVN-65) was towed from a pier at Newport News Shipbuilding on Monday, almost 15 years after its final deployment, USNI News has learned. “Ex-Enterprise began its final transit this morning, departing Newport News Shipbuilding for Mobile, Alabama, where the ship will be dismantled,” reads a Monday statement from PAE Maritime. The remnant “Big E” is now in route to Mobile, Ala., after a court battle between environmental disposal contractor NorthStar and HII over which company would oversee the final disposal. Last month, HII dropped a legal challenge on the Navy’s decision
